description: Trafikverket - WMS riksintresse trafikslagens anläggningar is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo-ri.trafikverket.se. The service contains the national interests for the Transport Act's facilities (air, rail, shipping and road). Both existing and planned and future national interests are presented. The previous four transport agencies, now the Swedish Transport Administration, have during autumn 2009 and spring 2010 been working on a cross-modal review of national interests. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Swedish Transport Administration - WMS national interest facilities of the Transport Act" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include visningstjänst, view service. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2013-02-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
